quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًۭا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ

يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌۭ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ

۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ
ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌۭ وَلَهْوٌۭ وَزِينَةٌۭ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌۭ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰمًۭا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَغْفِرَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ

سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍۢ فَخُورٍ
ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ

لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌۭ
وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًۭا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍۢ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةًۭ وَرَحْمَةًۭ وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًۭا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

parent_channels.name: P1 Sovereign Architecture of Passage

subchannels.name: The Elevated Court Between Canopy and Floor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A low terrestrial floor and an overhead canopy form a royal enclosure in which coursing motion proceeds beneath an elevated throne.
subchannels.active_motifs: extended coursing through water, air, or the celestial field `quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`; sky as canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; earth as the lower floor `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; sovereign kingdom `quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`; elevated royal throne `quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`; rising and settling upon `quranic:root_000766:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The canopy, lower floor, and throne convert a general statement of dominion into a bounded court. The latent coursing sense under `sabbaha` gives the realm motion: what moves through it does so inside an architecture already occupied and governed from above.

subchannels.name: Managed Apertures and Currents
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contents cross the world's surfaces inward and outward, while descending and ascending currents intersect the alternation of darkness and opened daylight.
subchannels.active_motifs: entering an interior `quranic:root_001682:B001/m01`; passing to the outside `quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`; downward arrival `quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`; upward ascent `quranic:root_000997:B004/m01`; night and darkness `quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`; day as an opening with light `quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ingress, egress, descent, and ascent are complementary directions in one circulation system. The insertion of night into day and day into night extends that same boundary-crossing operation from bodies and provisions to time and illumination.

subchannels.name: Endpoints Return to Command
subchannels.scene_or_process: First and last positions define a trajectory whose contents return to an originating disposition as settled affairs.
subchannels.active_motifs: beginning and priority `quranic:root_000067:B001/m01`; lastness and what comes after `quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`; return toward an outcome `quranic:root_000067:B002/m01`; return to an initial place or state `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; affair as a disposed state `quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same lexical field that marks firstness also reaches toward eventual outcome. Return is therefore not loose reversal but closure: affairs travel from priority through lastness and are restored to the authority that set their condition.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sovereignty appears as control over a vertically ordered realm and every movement through its boundaries, cycles, and endpoints.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:1-6 names the heavens, earth, throne, kingdom, ingress, egress, descent, ascent, night, day, firstness, lastness, return, and affairs.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Praise and cosmic order become a physical system of coursing bodies, canopy and floor, managed apertures, and directed return.

parent_channels.name: P1 Surfaces Open to Inward Knowledge

subchannels.name: Manifest Face and Concealed Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing presents an exposed face while retaining both a physical inside and a hidden meaning beneath that face.
subchannels.active_motifs: the manifest and exposed `quranic:root_000970:B001/m01`; a hidden interior of an affair `quranic:root_000128:B002/m01`; a physical inside `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; an exterior or back opposed to the belly `quranic:root_000970:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The manifest-hidden pair is more than an abstract contrast. Its physical branches supply a faced object with an outside and belly, allowing visibility and concealment to coexist as two aspects of one penetrable reality.

subchannels.name: The Breast as an Action Chamber
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intended deeds issue from an inner source that is disclosed to sight, knowledge, and expertise in concealed matters.
subchannels.active_motifs: the breast as a source from which actions issue `quranic:root_000849:B004/m01`; inward sight `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; a thing disclosed to a knower `quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`; expertise in an inner matter `quranic:root_000387:B001/m01`; intended action and work `quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The breast is cast as the chamber from which deliberate action emerges. Sight follows the outward deed, while knowledge and inward expertise reach upstream to its source, joining moral observation to an anatomy of intention.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An exposed surface never exhausts a thing; its concealed interior remains available to a mode of knowledge able to penetrate appearances and sources of action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:3 opposes the manifest and hidden, while 57:4, 57:6, and 57:10 join deeds, sight, breasts, knowledge, and inward expertise.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The divine names become an anatomy of surfaces and interiors, then relocate moral action to a source chamber within the breast.

parent_channels.name: P1 Binding Trust as Extraction Into Light

subchannels.name: A Summons Secures the Inward Bond
subchannels.scene_or_process: A voiced summons draws a hearer toward a message, while taking the covenant stabilizes assent as inward security.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart-security and trust `quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`; assent that calms the heart `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; vocal summons and drawing by speech `quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`; messenger as bearer of a message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; taking and holding possession `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`; a confirmed covenant `quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Belief is not left as unstructured assent. The messenger's summons draws the hearer, the covenant is taken and held, and the result is the settled inward security carried by the belief root.

subchannels.name: Descending Signs Conduct an Extraction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Disclosed signs descend as an instrument that extracts people from a zone of concealed or withheld right into visible orientation.
subchannels.active_motifs: downward delivery of a message `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; visible sign or landmark `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; clear disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; extraction from concealment or ignorance `quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`; withholding or misplacing a right `quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`; light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; tender compassion `quranic:root_000530:B001/m01`; mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The signs descend, disclose, and lead outward. The latent legal distortion inside the darkness root makes the scene an extraction from both obscurity and dispossession, while compassion and mercy explain why that transfer is undertaken.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Trust is secured by summons and covenant, then enacted as a revelatory transfer out of concealment and violated order into visible orientation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:7-9 joins belief, the messenger's call, covenant, descending signs, extraction from darkness, light, compassion, and mercy.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Darkness carries a latent juridical sense of a right withheld or misplaced, so illumination also performs restoration.

parent_channels.name: P1 Temporary Capital and Evaluated Release

subchannels.name: The Successor-Held Estate
subchannels.scene_or_process: An estate passes without the present holder originating it, and the successor is asked to release part of the transferred holding.
subchannels.active_motifs: a later holder succeeding an earlier one `quranic:root_000433:B001/m01`; inheritance transferred to a successor `quranic:root_001639:B001/m01`; ownership transferred without contract or effort `quranic:root_001639:B002/m01`; money leaving possession as expenditure `quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Succession and inheritance deny the fantasy of original ownership. Spending becomes the appropriate outward movement of an estate that arrived from before the present holder and will not terminate with that holder.

subchannels.name: Cut Capital Returns Enlarged
subchannels.scene_or_process: A portion is cut from present capital, advanced as a loan or trading stake, and returned as multiplied compensation.
subchannels.active_motifs: a cut portion given for return or reward `quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`; cut trading capital placed in partnership `quranic:root_001217:B004/m01`; increase by repeated likeness `quranic:root_000909:B002/m01`; compensating wage `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; noble generosity `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The good loan combines separation and return: value must first be cut away from the holder before it can circulate. Its multiplication resembles a partnership yield, but the final wage exceeds a merely commercial settlement through noble generosity.

subchannels.name: Timing Reprices the Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: Expenditure is compared around an opening event; commitment before and after conflict receives unequal placement on a graded scale.
subchannels.active_motifs: an opening of victory `quranic:root_001124:B004/m01`; mutual combat `quranic:root_001200:B011/m01`; equal valuation `quranic:root_000766:B001/m01`; after as counterpart to before `quranic:root_000131:B002/m01`; greatness in magnitude or power `quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`; stepwise gradation `quranic:root_000468:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same release of wealth changes value with historical position. Opening and combat create a threshold; crossing it alters the risk of commitment, so apparently equal acts occupy different steps in a measured hierarchy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Possessions are transferred capital rather than absolute property, and their release is valued by mode, timing, and eventual return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:7 and 57:10-11 connect succession, inheritance, spending, opening, combat, rank, loan, multiplication, and reward.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Inheritance and loan imagery place the giver between an earlier owner and a later reckoning, turning expenditure into stewardship of circulating capital.

parent_channels.name: P1 Light Controlled by Orientation and Enclosure

subchannels.name: Issued Light Marks a Moving Front
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light travels with its bearers, projecting ahead and along the right side as both directional equipment and a sign of authorized movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; purposeful movement `quranic:root_000709:B001/m01`; what lies ahead between the hands `quranic:root_001693:B008/m01`; the right hand or direction `quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`; the right as power or rightful side `quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`; beacon or landmark `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The light is not static illumination. It runs with a purposeful procession, establishes a forward field, and marks the right side as both direction and authorized power, functioning like a mobile beacon.

subchannels.name: Borrowed Fire Reverses the Seeker
subchannels.scene_or_process: Excluded seekers attempt to take flame from another source, but are sent backward to search for an ignition that remains concealed on the far side.
subchannels.active_motifs: flame taken from a source `quranic:root_001196:B001/m01`; light or good borrowed from another `quranic:root_001196:B002/m01`; dormant fire elicited from flint `quranic:root_001642:B002/m01`; repeated searching by contact `quranic:root_001377:B002/m01`; return to an earlier place or state `quranic:root_000544:B001/m01`; the rear or other side of a barrier `quranic:root_001642:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Borrowing presumes that another person's radiance can be tapped like a flame. The command to return behind converts that expectation into a futile ignition search; the same lexical field joins the hidden fire to the inaccessible far side.

subchannels.name: The Wall Sorts Mercy From Pain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A struck boundary separates a formerly joined crowd, and its gate exposes radically different conditions on its inward and outward faces.
subchannels.active_motifs: striking one thing upon another `quranic:root_000906:B001/m01`; separation after joining `quranic:root_000170:B001/m01`; elevated surrounding wall `quranic:root_000758:B002/m01`; entrance or gate `quranic:root_000163:B001/m01`; physical inside `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; exterior or back opposed to the inside `quranic:root_000970:B002/m01`; mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; punishment and pain `quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`; hypocrisy as a visible door with a hidden exit `quranic:root_001537:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The wall makes an ethical distinction spatially irreversible: one structure has an inward field of mercy and an outward field of pain. The door-and-hidden-exit image within hypocrisy makes the hypocrite structurally akin to this divided architecture, outwardly accessible but inwardly routed elsewhere.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Light is an allocated capacity for movement whose availability depends on direction, access, and the boundary between inside and outside.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:12-13 gives moving light to the front and right, stages an attempted borrowing, commands a reversal, and erects a gated wall between mercy and punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hypocrisy itself carries the architecture of a visible door with a concealed outlet, matching the moral split to the wall's two faces.

parent_channels.name: P1 Self-Assay and Deferred Ruin

subchannels.name: The Self Fed Into the Furnace
subchannels.scene_or_process: The inner person is placed under an assay that heats, darkens, distinguishes quality, and exposes deviation.
subchannels.active_motifs: assaying metal or a person to distinguish good from bad `quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`; burning and blackening in fire `quranic:root_001128:B002/m01`; bending away from truth `quranic:root_001128:B003/m01`; the self or essence `quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`; inner intention and reason `quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: To tempt the self is lexically to put it through an assay. Yet this furnace does not purify automatically: heat can disclose poor material, blacken it, and reveal an inward bend away from truth.

subchannels.name: Waiting Trades Certainty for False Shine
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person holds position like a trader withholding stock, while doubt and imagined outcomes gain value from a deceptive surface until the decisive affair arrives.
subchannels.active_motifs: waiting and watching `quranic:root_000534:B001/m01`; holding a commodity for an expected price `quranic:root_000534:B002/m01`; disturbed doubt `quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`; a wish imaged in the heart `quranic:root_001450:B004/m01`; fantasies fabricated without reality `quranic:root_001450:B013/m01`; deception by unstable shine `quranic:root_001078:B008/m01`; exposure to an unknown outcome `quranic:root_001078:B009/m01`; arrival `quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`; affair as a disposed state `quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Waiting is a speculative operation: the holder delays action because an imagined future price appears better. Doubt, wish, and unstable shine sustain that position only until arrival fixes the affair and the unknown outcome can no longer be traded as possibility.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Delay subjects the inner self to processes that reveal its quality, whether as material under heat or judgment held back by speculation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:14 joins self-temptation, waiting, doubt, wishes, deception, and the arrival of the command.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Self-temptation becomes metallurgical assay, while waiting becomes the speculative retention of goods for a hoped-for price.

parent_channels.name: P2 Receptive Substrate: Hard Core to Living Ground

subchannels.name: Long Exposure Calcifies the Inner Core
subchannels.scene_or_process: Extended duration acts on the heart's core until a faculty meant to lower itself becomes dry, hard, and unresponsive to reminder.
subchannels.active_motifs: an endpoint or due term `quranic:root_000050:B001/m01`; prolonged duration `quranic:root_000959:B003/m01`; heart `quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`; inner core or essence `quranic:root_001248:B002/m01`; hardness and dryness like unproductive land `quranic:root_001227:B001/m01`; a hard heart stripped of softness and mercy `quranic:root_001227:B002/m01`; lowering and humility `quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`; reminder `quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Time does not merely pass over the heart; it alters the receiving material. The core loses softness, assumes the dryness of non-growing ground, and can no longer perform the lowering movement appropriate to reminder.

subchannels.name: Dormant Ground Receives Life and Meaning
subchannels.scene_or_process: A low and dormant ground is revived from uncultivated death, while disclosed signs activate the faculty that restrains ignorance.
subchannels.active_motifs: low dormant ground `quranic:root_000412:B002/m01`; dead uncultivated land `quranic:root_001454:B003/m01`; stillness and dormancy `quranic:root_001454:B012/m01`; soft fertile earth `quranic:root_000025:B002/m01`; earth enlivened through rain and growth `quranic:root_000383:B002/m01`; visible sign or landmark `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; explanatory disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; reason that restrains ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The lowered quality sought from the heart has an earthy counterpart: ground lying still before revival. Life restores growth to that substrate, and explanation performs the corresponding cognitive work by making signs available to a reason capable of restraining inert ignorance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reception depends on material disposition; an inner or earthly substrate may harden into sterility or soften into life under a descending address.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:16-17 moves from humbled or hardened hearts under descended truth to earth revived after death and signs opened for reason.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The humility root also supplies a low, dormant landscape, making the heart and earth parallel receiving grounds rather than a loose moral simile.

parent_channels.name: P2 Truth Converted to Public Value

subchannels.name: Charity Acts as Fulfilled Credit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Charitable transfer fulfills a commitment, advances a cut portion as credit, and returns it as multiplied, honorable compensation.
subchannels.active_motifs: charity or an owed charitable right `quranic:root_000852:B006/m01`; an act that fulfills its promise `quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`; a cut portion advanced for return `quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`; increase by repeated likeness `quranic:root_000909:B002/m01`; compensating wage `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; noble generosity `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Charity is truth made transactional: the giver's commitment is fulfilled by an actual transfer. Loan and multiplication then place that fulfillment into an economy where relinquished value returns as both compensation and honor.

subchannels.name: Belief Stands as Testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: Belief matures into a sound public standing whose bearers are present as witnesses and receive recognized proximity, reward, and light.
subchannels.active_motifs: assent that settles the heart `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; truthful utterance `quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`; sound and complete standing `quranic:root_000852:B003/m01`; witness-presence `quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`; testimony grounded in knowledge `quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`; proximity and presence near another `quranic:root_001052:B004/m01`; compensating reward `quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`; light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Truthfulness is not only speech but stable standing. Believers become people whose position can bear testimony; reward, nearness, and light are the visible recognition of that completed public role.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Inward truth becomes publicly legible through fulfilled transfer and sound standing, producing both financial credit and testimonial rank.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:18-19 links charitable giving, loan, multiplication, truthful standing, witnesses, reward, proximity, and light.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The truth root coordinates charitable release and reliable testimony, treating generosity and witness as two realizations of a fulfilled commitment.

parent_channels.name: P2 Opposite Operations of Covering

subchannels.name: Covering Blocks Truth and Light
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cover is laid across truth, converting denial into an obstruction that rejects signs and stands opposite the believers' light.
subchannels.active_motifs: generic covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; obstructing truth through disbelief `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; falsehood opposed to truth `quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`; visible sign or landmark `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Disbelief is materialized as a cover placed between a person and disclosed evidence. Denial reinforces that obstruction by declaring the signs false, while the nearby light marks the visibility from which the cover excludes its bearer.

subchannels.name: Covering Shelters Seed Until Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cultivator covers seed in receptive soil; rain then draws the concealed planting into visible growth.
subchannels.active_motifs: a farmer covering seed with earth `quranic:root_001307:B008/m01`; rain `quranic:root_001118:B001/m01`; a plant emerging and growing `quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The cultivator's cover has the same physical shape as concealment but the opposite outcome. It protects a buried beginning until rain can materialize it as growth, preserving covering as a productive rather than obstructive operation.

subchannels.name: Covering Protects the Offender
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protective layer is placed over offense and offender, effacing exposure and keeping the person within a guarded boundary.
subchannels.active_motifs: a cover that protects `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a sin and protecting its bearer `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; effacing an offense by covering it `quranic:root_001307:B009/m01`; protective barrier `quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Forgiveness is pictured as shelter rather than denial of what occurred. The latent atoning branch of the disbelief root turns the cover around: instead of blocking truth from the person, it blocks the offense from destroying the person.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Covering changes moral function according to what it does to its object: it can obstruct truth, incubate life, or shield a person by effacing offense.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 57:19-21 and 57:28 place disbelief, cultivators, signs, light, forgiveness, and protection within one interval.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The disbelief root can name both obstructive covering and a farmer's productive covering of seed, while an atoning branch reverses concealment into protection.

parent_channels.name: P2 Inflated Display Collapses Into Dry Fragments

subchannels.name: Status Display Expands by Counting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A social field is occupied by purposeless play, diversion, beautified display, and competitive counting of possessions and descendants.
subchannels.active_motifs: purposeless play `quranic:root_001358:B001/m01`; distraction from what matters `quranic:root_001382:B001/m01`; improving something for display `quranic:root_000660:B002/m01`; adornment `quranic:root_000660:B003/m01`; boasting by recounting achievements `quranic:root_001135:B001/m01`; rivalry through increasing number `quranic:root_001286:B002/m01`; accumulated wealth `quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`; offspring `quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`; deception by unstable shine `quranic:root_001078:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Play and diversion prepare a stage on which adornment and boasting can operate. Wealth and children become countable display units, and their increase acquires the unstable shine that lets a temporary arrangement impersonate lasting worth.

subchannels.name: Wet Growth Empties Into Debris
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain swells a pleasing crop, but the growth reaches a dry yellow state, empties of vitality, and shatters into fragments fit only for temporary use.
subchannels.active_motifs: rain `quranic:root_001118:B001/m01`; growth produced by rain `quranic:root_001118:B002/m01`; a plant emerging and growing `quranic:root_001465:B001/m01`; what pleases the eye `quranic:root_000984:B003/m01`; a plant yellowing and drying `quranic:root_001612:B001/m01`; yellow color `quranic:root_000869:B001/m01`; an emptied or vacant vessel `quranic:root_000869:B002/m01`; dry matter shattered into fragments `quranic:root_000337:B001/m01`; transient worldly debris `quranic:root_000337:B009/m01`; temporary utility `quranic:root_001395:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The crop's apparent fullness is a phase, not a settled property. Yellowing joins visible color to latent vacancy, and shattering reveals the swollen form as temporary material whose final value is no more than passing use.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What expands to attract attention is structurally temporary; social accumulation and vegetative swelling both end in exposed emptiness and debris.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:20 aligns play, distraction, adornment, boasting, numerical rivalry, wealth, children, rain-fed growth, yellowing, fragments, and deceptive utility.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Numerical rivalry and water-swollen vegetation become parallel inflation processes, each mistaking temporary increase for durable substance.

parent_channels.name: P2 Distributed Bounty Equips a Path

subchannels.name: The Race Enters Prepared Breadth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Racers move toward a protected enclosure whose canopy-to-ground breadth has already been set out and made ready.
subchannels.active_motifs: racing for precedence `quranic:root_000671:B001/m01`; forgiveness as protective covering `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`; enclosed garden `quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`; breadth `quranic:root_001001:B001/m01`; sky as canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; earth as the lower floor `quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`; prepared equipment or reserve `quranic:root_000989:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The garden is spatial capacity prepared before the racers arrive. Its breadth stretches between canopy and ground, while forgiveness supplies a protected entry condition, turning the destination into ready-made room for movement and settlement.

subchannels.name: Double Provision Becomes a Walking Beacon
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected traveler receives two carried shares of mercy and a beacon by which movement can continue.
subchannels.active_motifs: placing the self within protection `quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`; assent that settles the heart `quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`; a carried share or double portion `quranic:root_001309:B002/m01`; mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; beacon or landmark `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`; walking `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The two portions are not an inert allotment. They accompany a protected believer as carried provision, while light becomes a route marker that makes continued walking possible.

subchannels.name: Bounty Resides in the Giving Hand
subchannels.scene_or_process: Surplus remains under an owning hand that possesses the capacity to grant, favor, and hand it over.
subchannels.active_motifs: surplus or remainder `quranic:root_001163:B001/m01`; freely given favor `quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`; hand as favor `quranic:root_001693:B003/m01`; owning and controlling hand `quranic:root_001693:B004/m01`; handover `quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`; giving `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; capacity and possession `quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Bounty is simultaneously surplus, favor, and transferable possession. The hand holds these senses together: it owns the reserve, exercises the capacity to give, and completes the passage into another's possession.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bounty is allocated as usable capacity for movement: prepared room, carried shares, protective light, and a transfer from an owning hand.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:21 and 57:28-29 join racing, prepared breadth, garden, protection, double portions, mercy, walking light, bounty, hand, giving, and capacity.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Garden, mercy, and light form a travel provision rather than a static prize, while the hand image identifies the source as an owner able to transfer surplus.

parent_channels.name: P2 Inscribed Impact Steadies Affect

subchannels.name: The Impact Is Entered Before It Lands
subchannels.scene_or_process: A target-like event arrives as a calamity only after its occurrence has already been inscribed and measured before creation.
subchannels.active_motifs: a projectile or act reaching its target `quranic:root_000889:B003/m01`; calamity as a striking event `quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`; written document `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; inscription that imposes a decree or measure `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; bringing into creation `quranic:root_000099:B001/m01`; ease `quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The event is first an entry in a record and then an impact in the world or self. Its projectile sense gives calamity a trajectory, while inscription establishes that the apparent collision belongs to a prior measure and is therefore easy to encompass.

subchannels.name: Record Narrows Emotional Oscillation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A missed object passes through a gap and a received object arrives as gift; grief and exultation are restrained from becoming opposing forms of self-display.
subchannels.active_motifs: failing to reach or retain `quranic:root_001183:B001/m01`; a gap through which something escapes `quranic:root_001183:B004/m01`; grief over what was missed `quranic:root_000034:B004/m01`; giving and received gift `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; joy `quranic:root_001140:B001/m01`; exultant joy `quranic:root_001140:B002/m01`; swaggering self-display `quranic:root_000454:B003/m01`; boasting by recounting advantage `quranic:root_001135:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Loss is pictured as something slipping beyond reach through an opening, while gain is explicitly something brought to the recipient. The prior inscription removes neither response, but prevents the two trajectories from expanding into consuming grief or boastful exultation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Events are fixed before they strike, and knowledge of that inscription narrows the emotional swing between missed possession and received gift.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:22-23 joins calamity, earth and self, a prior book, creation, ease, missed things, received gifts, grief, exultation, swagger, and boasting.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Calamity behaves like a projectile reaching its target, while what escapes is a literal gap; the prior record reframes both hit and miss as measured trajectories.

parent_channels.name: P2 Justice Stands on Calibrated and Hard Instruments

subchannels.name: The Message Establishes a Public Balance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A disclosed message and assembled document install a balance by which people can stand in upright, equitable relation.
subchannels.active_motifs: messenger as bearer of a message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; clear disclosure `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; joining parts, letters, or material `quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`; written document `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; justice-bearing balance `quranic:root_001645:B002/m01`; uprightness and equilibrium `quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`; equity `quranic:root_001224:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Disclosure supplies intelligible terms, the book joins and preserves them, and the balance tests their proportion. The outcome is not private correctness but a people able to stand together in an equitable posture.

subchannels.name: Iron Gives the Measure an Edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hard material supplies boundary, penetration, force, and bundled strength, benefiting people while revealing who will support the message without visible assurance.
subchannels.active_motifs: iron and hardness `quranic:root_000002:B004/m01`; boundary or limit `quranic:root_000002:B001/m01`; sharp edge and penetration `quranic:root_000002:B005/m01`; martial force `quranic:root_000079:B001/m01`; strength and solidity `quranic:root_000782:B002/m01`; strength bundled like rope strands `quranic:root_001274:B001/m01`; benefit `quranic:root_001536:B001/m01`; support `quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`; hidden or unseen condition `quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Balance defines proportion; iron gives that proportion a resistant edge. Its hardness can stop, separate, or penetrate, and its useful force makes support consequential even when the final authority behind the standard remains unseen.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Public equity requires both a standard that makes right proportion visible and a hard implement that turns proportion into an enforceable boundary.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:25 joins messengers, clear signs, book, balance, upright public equity, iron, force, benefit, support, and the unseen.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Iron is not only weapon or material; its lexical edge and boundary make it the hard counterpart of balance, converting measure into a limit that can hold.

parent_channels.name: P2 Transmission as Trail and Stewardship

subchannels.name: Lineage Scatters Revelation as Seed
subchannels.scene_or_process: A founding line disperses descendants like seed, places prophecy and book among them, and produces both guided growth and fruit that breaks out of its proper enclosure.
subchannels.active_motifs: filiation and lineage `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; scattered grain or seed `quranic:root_000511:B002/m01`; prophet as intermediary `quranic:root_001464:B003/m01`; written document `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; gentle guidance to a road or truth `quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`; ripe fruit exiting its peel `quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Biological descent is recast as dissemination: a lineage scatters carriers through whom prophecy and book can continue. The fruit image inside transgression gives the same growth process a divergent outcome, with some produce leaving the containing order rather than maturing within it.

subchannels.name: Messengers Follow an Inherited Track
subchannels.scene_or_process: Successive messengers move after predecessors by following an enduring trace step by step.
subchannels.active_motifs: lasting trace `quranic:root_000011:B003/m01`; walking after a predecessor `quranic:root_000011:B004/m01`; following a trace in sequence `quranic:root_001247:B001/m01`; following or imitating another `quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`; tracking step by step `quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`; dispatching a messenger `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Succession is rendered as locomotion over an existing path. The prior carrier leaves a durable mark; the next is dispatched into that track, follows it, and extends rather than restarts the line of transmission.

subchannels.name: Invented Discipline Lacks a Shepherd
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fear-driven discipline is invented to seek approval, but the institution fails when its adherents do not preserve it with the care owed to a flock or covenant.
subchannels.active_motifs: inventing without precedent `quranic:root_000094:B001/m01`; fear-driven worship and monasticism `quranic:root_000604:B003/m01`; seeking `quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`; sought approval `quranic:root_000569:B002/m01`; tender compassion `quranic:root_000530:B001/m01`; mercy `quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`; a shepherd's care and governance `quranic:root_000574:B002/m01`; preserving and caring for a covenant `quranic:root_000574:B006/m01`; a truth or due that must be guarded `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Invention alone does not explain the failure. The discipline is a humanly formed vessel aimed at approval, but once formed it requires shepherding: compassionate governance, preservation of its due, and faithful care for what its adherents undertook.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Guidance persists through carriers who reproduce a legacy as lineage, followed trace, and cared-for institution.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 57:26-27 joins descendants, prophecy, book, guidance, transgression, messenger succession, traces, following, compassion, mercy, invented monasticism, approval, and failed care.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Descendants become scattered grain, messengers walk an inherited track, and institutional failure appears as a shepherd's failure to guard what was entrusted.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 No-Ransom Custody
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Captives reach a final custody in which no exchange is accepted and the fire itself becomes refuge, guardian, claimant, and settled destination.
parent_channels.active_motifs: taking and holding possession `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`; capture and prisonerhood `quranic:root_000018:B003/m01`; prisoner exchange or ransom `quranic:root_001136:B002/m01`; refuge and gathering place `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; fire `quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`; guardian or administrator `quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`; rightful claimant or one with priority `quranic:root_001684:B008/m01`; final dwelling and place of settlement `quranic:root_000897:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The failed ransom implies a prisoner who cannot buy release. Custody then closes around the captive: the only refuge is also the administering guardian and rightful claimant, so destination and captor collapse into the same fire.

parent_channels.name: S2. P2 Commanded Withholding
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Private refusal to release possessions becomes a social command that reproduces withholding, while withdrawal is exposed as a false claim to self-sufficiency.
parent_channels.active_motifs: withholding possessions from where they are due `quranic:root_000089:B001/m01`; command and imposed obligation `quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`; turning away `quranic:root_001684:B007/m01`; wealth and imagined self-sufficiency `quranic:root_001110:B001/m01`; true sufficiency `quranic:root_001110:B002/m01`; praise opposed to blame `quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Withholding is not confined to a closed hand; it recruits others by turning refusal into instruction. The one who withdraws behaves as if wealth made the self independent, but the closing names transfer sufficiency and praise away from the hoarder to the source that needs no retained possession.

parent_channels.name: S3. Whole-Surah Wedding Transfer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A marriage is contracted, its dower is transferred, the bride is conveyed to the husband, and entry beneath the wedding pavilion establishes a new household.
parent_channels.active_motifs: taking a spouse and becoming a household `quranic:root_000064:B002/m01`; marriage contract and espousal `quranic:root_001444:B004/m01`; bridal dower `quranic:root_000852:B007/m01`; bride conveyed to her husband `quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`; building upon one's wife and entering beneath the wedding pavilion `quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Contract, payment, conveyance, and entry form one ordered transfer into household. The scene makes the surah's kingdom, truthful giving, guidance, lineage, and people-of-the-book vocabulary concrete as covenantal incorporation: bounty establishes obligations and a durable household rather than merely enlarging private possession.

parent_channels.name: S4. Whole-Surah Embodied Prayer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A call gathers worshippers, who orient toward a prayer direction, stand bodily in devotion, and count repeated praise on beads.
parent_channels.active_motifs: the call "come to prayer" `quranic:root_000383:B009/m01`; worship through praise and prayer `quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`; beads used to count praise `quranic:root_000666:B006/m01`; prayer direction toward which worshippers turn `quranic:root_001198:B005/m01`; bodily standing in prayer or remembrance `quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The call, orientation, posture, and counting instrument make praise a repeatable embodied rite. This materializes the surah's opening cosmic praise and its command that people stand in equity as disciplined alignment, while pressing devotion away from unstructured withdrawal and toward a shared, directed practice.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole-Surah Marked-Lot Game
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Smooth marked lots are gathered in a leather receptacle, including a named fifth arrow; players draw for portions of a slaughtered camel, and a winning lot emerges for its owner.
parent_channels.active_motifs: a smoothed arrow or lot `quranic:root_000434:B008/m01`; a mark distinguishing a lot `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`; leather receptacle holding gambling arrows `quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`; the fifth gambling arrow `quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`; arrow-game and division of camel portions `quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`; winning when one's lot comes out `quranic:root_001186:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The container, differentiated implements, draw, and allocated meat constitute a specific game of chance rather than a generic play motif. It usefully pressures the surah's worldly play, numerical rivalry, gains, and emotional exultation: what looks like a lucky share drawn for the self is set against events already inscribed before they arrive, and the surah's great success is no random winning lot.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole-Surah Leather Water-Skin
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A surface is stripped into hide, its hair is retained, a measured tanning dose treats the pelt, and stitched panels produce the side of a useful water-skin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stripping skin from a surface `quranic:root_000120:B004/m01`; hair-on hide retained during skinning or tanning `quranic:root_000844:B006/m01`; a small measured dose of tanning agent `quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`; sewing hide to hide along a thick edge `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`; leather side-panel of a water-skin `quranic:root_001536:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The operations proceed from exposed surface to treated material and finally to a joined vessel. This reframes the surah's self-assay and promised benefit as craft transformation: usefulness is produced by measured treatment, selective retention, and repaired joining, not by leaving the original surface untouched.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole-Surah Layered Camel Rig
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An under-saddle cloth, belly girth, level riding pad, pillion wrap, and raised howdah are layered onto a load-bearing mount.
parent_channels.active_motifs: girth fastened beneath a camel's belly `quranic:root_000128:B006/m01`; cloth placed beneath a saddle `quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`; level riding pad on a camel's back `quranic:root_000766:B010/m01`; wrapped cloth supporting a pillion rider `quranic:root_001309:B003/m01`; mount and carried riding equipment `quranic:root_000970:B005/m01`; raised howdah for a woman on a camel `quranic:root_001000:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The rig is a precise assembly: inner strap, outer back, leveling layer, adjacent underlay, second rider's share, and raised enclosure distribute weight so travel can continue. It materializes the surah's path, race, walking light, and double portion as supported passage, while recasting throne, inside and outside, equality, and guardianship as load-bearing relations rather than isolated abstractions.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole-Surah Cooperative Well Drawing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A water-rich shaft is timbered at its mouth, water carriers take alternating turns at the draw, and the waterers drink from a full bucket.
parent_channels.active_motifs: well shaft before or after lining `quranic:root_001248:B007/m01`; deep store of well water `quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`; timbered well mouth and platform for the drawer `quranic:root_001000:B004/m01`; circulating water carrier `quranic:root_000163:B006/m01`; water drawers succeeding one another by turns `quranic:root_000433:B011/m01`; waterers drinking from a full bucket `quranic:root_001274:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Shaft, stored water, built platform, rotating labor, and shared bucket form a complete extraction practice. The scene materializes descent and ascent, opening, succession, strength, and bounty as cooperative access to a hidden reserve: succession means taking a turn at drawing and transmitting provision, not owning the source.

parent_channels.name: S9. Whole-Surah Ordered Hive and Honey
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A bee leader orders a following colony whose secretion becomes honey, remains in wax comb before pressing, and thickens into a mixed, settled product.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bee leader followed by the rest `quranic:root_001444:B008/m01`; bee secretion as honey `quranic:root_001358:B003/m01`; honey held in wax comb before pressing `quranic:root_000822:B007/m01`; thick mixed honey or comb `quranic:root_000906:B015/m01`; honey curdling and settling at its endpoint `quranic:root_000067:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Leadership, animal production, comb, pressing, and thickening form one ordered food process. This reframes the surah's kingdom, following, witness, and bounty as productive coordination: authority culminates in a stored, shareable yield, and the apparent play-root contains disciplined animal labor rather than empty diversion.

parent_channels.name: S10. Whole-Surah Burial Into Concealment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A completed death is marked by laying the body on its right side, covering it with shroud and grave, and removing it from sight through burial.
parent_channels.active_motifs: one completed state of death `quranic:root_001454:B008/m01`; laying the dead on the right side `quranic:root_001698:B007/m01`; shrouding and covering the dead in a grave `quranic:root_000266:B009/m01`; hiding a body through burial `quranic:root_001117:B009/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Orientation, wrapping, grave, and disappearance form a complete interment sequence. It materializes the surah's life-death and seen-unseen axes: the body is deliberately placed on the right and then progressively covered, sharpening the difference between a protective covering that preserves a living person and burial covering that records completed mortality.

parent_channels.name: S11. Whole-Surah Fracture Set Straight
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A solid bone is fractured, set and allowed to heal, then judged by whether crookedness has been corrected into straight, stable integrity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: solid bone `quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`; setting a fracture that may heal crooked `quranic:root_000015:B002/m01`; straightening and completion after crookedness `quranic:root_000766:B002/m01`; solidity and evenness `quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Bone, break, setting, and restored alignment form a compact orthopedic process. The scene reframes the surah's reward, equality, truthfulness, and upright justice as reparative labor: recompense is not merely payment but the work of restoring a damaged structure until it can bear weight in a sound relation.

parent_channels.name: S12. Cross-Pericope Bridge: Descent Installs Capacity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (57:1-15) remains canonical at "Descending Signs Conduct an Extraction"; P2 (57:16-29) remains canonical at "Dormant Ground Receives Life and Meaning" and "The Message Establishes a Public Balance." Bridge (repeated causal sequence and role progression): delivery from above places a capacity into progressively larger receivers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: delivering a thing downward to its receiver `quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`; placing a delivered thing in its proper station `quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The local extraction, ground-revival, and justice scenes retain their canonical placements. Their bridge is the repeated descent operation: signs install orientation in persons, truth activates heart and earth, and book, balance, and iron install public capacity. The receiver progresses from person to substrate to polity, while the invariant remains an externally delivered power made effective by proper placement.

parent_channels.name: S13. Cross-Pericope Bridge: Light Is Granted, Not Borrowed
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (57:1-15) remains canonical at "Issued Light Marks a Moving Front" and "Borrowed Fire Reverses the Seeker"; P2 (57:16-29) remains canonical at "Belief Stands as Testimony" and "Double Provision Becomes a Walking Beacon." Bridge (contrast and role progression): attempted lateral borrowing fails, whereas granted light becomes durable locomotion.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: light or good borrowed from another `quranic:root_001196:B002/m01`; light `quranic:root_001564:B001/m01`; beacon or landmark `quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`; walking `quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge reverses the acquisition role. In P1, an excluded seeker tries to tap a peer's already issued light after separation; in P2, truthful standing and mercy precede a light assigned to its own bearer. What cannot be borrowed sideways is granted as a beacon and converted into forward movement.

parent_channels.name: S14. Cross-Pericope Bridge: Possession Is a Relay
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (57:1-15) remains canonical at "The Successor-Held Estate" and "Cut Capital Returns Enlarged"; P2 (57:16-29) remains canonical at "Charity Acts as Fulfilled Credit," "Bounty Resides in the Giving Hand," and "Commanded Withholding." Bridge (shared invariant, role progression, and reversal): a holder receives value, releases it, and passes it onward, while withholding arrests the relay.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: a later holder succeeding an earlier one `quranic:root_000433:B001/m01`; ownership transferred without contract or effort `quranic:root_001639:B002/m01`; a cut portion advanced for return `quranic:root_001217:B003/m01`; handover `quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`; withholding possessions from where they are due `quranic:root_000089:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge assigns possession a temporal role rather than restating the local financial scenes. Value reaches a successor, is cut loose as credit, and remains available for handover from the owning hand; the holder is one station in its movement. Withholding is the exact reversal because it converts a relay position into a false endpoint.

parent_channels.name: S15. Cross-Pericope Bridge: Covenant Must Become Care
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (57:1-15) remains canonical at "A Summons Secures the Inward Bond"; P2 (57:16-29) remains canonical at "Messengers Follow an Inherited Track" and "Invented Discipline Lacks a Shepherd." Bridge (role progression and reversal): a bond first taken must later be transmitted and actively maintained, while failed care undoes its intended continuity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: confirmed covenant `quranic:root_001623:B004/m01`; following a trace in sequence `quranic:root_001247:B001/m01`; preserving and caring for a covenant `quranic:root_000574:B006/m01`; a truth or due that must be guarded `quranic:root_000347:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is a temporal progression in covenant roles. P1 establishes the bond at reception; P2 asks later carriers to follow its trace and preserve its due. Monastic failure is therefore not a separate topic but a reversal of covenant completion: initiation occurred, yet shepherding did not sustain what had been undertaken.

parent_channels.name: S16. Cross-Pericope Bridge: Boundary Function Reverses
parent_channels.scene_or_process: P1 (57:1-15) remains canonical at "The Wall Sorts Mercy From Pain"; P2 (57:16-29) remains canonical at "Covering Blocks Truth and Light" and "Covering Protects the Offender." Bridge (repeated scene signature and role reversal): a boundary's moral effect changes according to what it excludes and from whom.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bridge hinges only: elevated surrounding wall `quranic:root_000758:B002/m01`; physical inside `quranic:root_000128:B001/m01`; exterior opposed to the inside `quranic:root_000970:B002/m01`; obstructing truth through disbelief `quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`; a cover that protects `quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`; covering a sin and protecting its bearer `quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: P1's wall sorts persons by placing mercy and pain on opposite sides. P2 repeats the interface but reverses its object: disbelief puts a cover between the person and truth, while forgiveness puts a cover between offense and the person. The bridge is therefore not generic enclosure but a precise reversal in which side of the boundary receives protection.

parent_channels.name: S17. Whole-Surah Infected Wound Under Treatment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A boil breaks the body's surface, pus collects, corruption spreads through the wound, and a practitioner treats and sutures it; apparent improvement may relapse before recovery.
parent_channels.active_motifs: boil or ulcer emerging from the body `quranic:root_000400:B004/m01`; pus collected in a wound `quranic:root_000282:B003/m01`; wound swelling and spreading into corruption `quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`; medical treatment and suturing `quranic:root_000034:B001/m01`; relapse after apparent improvement `quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`; recovery from illness `quranic:root_000099:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Emergence, suppuration, spread, suturing, relapse, and recovery form one clinical cycle. It reframes the surah's hardened heart, revived ground, forgiveness, and failed care as wound management: concealment of damage is not healing, apparent improvement may reverse, and restoration requires treatment sustained until corruption no longer advances.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole-Surah Birth Requires Reception and Aftercare
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A mother delivers, a midwife receives the child into her hands, blood and afterbirth emerge, and retained afterbirth or uterine pain calls for continued care.
parent_channels.active_motifs: delivery of a child `quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`; midwife receiving the newborn into her hands `quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`; blood and afterbirth emerging with birth `quranic:root_000822:B006/m01`; postpartum uterine pain or retained afterbirth `quranic:root_000552:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Delivery is not self-completing: another person receives the new life, and the maternal body remains vulnerable after the child appears. The scene materializes prophetic lineage and successor transmission as an embodied passage requiring reception and aftercare, while the mercy root reaches into the injured womb and makes care integral to continuity.

parent_channels.name: S19. Whole-Surah Bereaved Dam Accepts a Foster Calf
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After a dam loses her offspring, a rolled cloth is used in a fostering procedure that induces her to accept and foster another's calf.
parent_channels.active_motifs: parent or dam bereaved of offspring `quranic:root_001454:B005/m01`; rolled cloth used in camel fostering `quranic:root_000468:B007/m01`; induced acceptance of another dam's young `quranic:root_000468:B007/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Death breaks biological succession, but a precise husbandry intervention redirects maternal care toward a surviving dependent. This usefully pressures the surah's lineage and shepherding sequence: continuity need not rest on origin alone, because deliberate care can sustain a life outside its first line of descent.

parent_channels.name: S20. Whole-Surah Worn Cloth Is Reworked
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A garment loses its nap and tears through use; the worn place is repaired, old cloth is reworked after unraveling, and a tight weave restores integrity.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cloth worn, torn, and stripped of its nap `quranic:root_000434:B009/m01`; repair at a worn place `quranic:root_000433:B007/m01`; cloth reworked after unraveling or wear `quranic:root_000544:B015/m01`; tight and sound weaving `quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Wear, localized repair, reworking, and tight weaving form one textile-restoration process. The scene pressures the surah's account of adornment collapsing into debris: transience remains real, but damaged material can still be responsibly remade into a sound structure rather than abandoned at the first sign of decay.

parent_channels.name: S21. Whole-Surah Guest Meal Comes Off the Fire
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A butcher-cook tends a covered pot until the meat and rendered fat reach doneness, then uses a cloth to lift the hot vessel and serves prepared provision to an arriving guest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking pot `quranic:root_001205:B007/m01`; butcher-cook overseeing slaughter and cooking `quranic:root_001205:B007/m02`; rendered fat rising from the meat `quranic:root_000064:B006/m01`; food reaching doneness `quranic:root_000063:B003/m01`; lid covering the pot `quranic:root_001294:B005/m01`; cloth used to remove a hot pot `quranic:root_000248:B007/m01`; prepared food for an arriving guest `quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Vessel, cook, fat, lid, measured doneness, heat cloth, and guest provision make bounty a prepared act of hospitality. Descent and arrival are thereby reframed as a host-receiver relation: provision becomes useful through timed heat, protective covering, skilled handling, and release to the newcomer rather than through possession of ingredients alone.

parent_channels.name: S22. Whole-Surah Spent Light Becomes a Tattooed Record
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Soot from a fat-fed wick is used as pigment on punctured skin, and the dark lines are retraced to renew the inscription.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wick or fat soot used as tattoo pigment `quranic:root_001564:B008/m01`; puncturing skin and dusting it with soot `quranic:root_001564:B008/m02`; retracing and reblackening tattoo lines `quranic:root_000544:B009/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: A source of flame leaves dark residue that is driven into the body and periodically renewed as a fixed surface record. This reverses the surah's walking light: illumination enables movement, whereas spent light becomes a static ornamental mark, pressing visible inscription to be distinguished from the living guidance it can only imitate.

parent_channels.name: S23. Whole-Surah Written Installments Purchase Freedom
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An enslaved person enters a written manumission contract, earns successive portions of the stipulated price, and crosses into the legal clientage created by emancipation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: enslaved and saleable person `quranic:root_000973:B001/m01`; written contract with staged payments leading to manumission `quranic:root_001283:B005/m01`; labor and earnings applied to one's own freedom price `quranic:root_000709:B005/m01`; legal clientage following emancipation `quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Contract, scheduled debt, labor, and changed status form a complete emancipation mechanism. It makes writing and credit instruments of release while time and agency remain, and thereby sharpens the surah's final no-ransom custody: an obligation can mediate freedom before the terminal settlement, but no deferred purchase remains once that custody closes.

parent_channels.name: S24. Whole-Surah Irrigation Routes Water Into Reserve
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Water is released from an outlet, directed through a channel, held in a basin, and replenished by feeder gullies arriving from a distance.
parent_channels.active_motifs: water outlet opened toward crops `quranic:root_001124:B005/m01`; channel directing flow into a basin `quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`; catch basin retaining water for days `quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`; distant feeder gullies supplying a pool `quranic:root_001510:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Outlet, channel, reservoir, and feeder form a compact distribution system distinct from drawing water out of a well. It materializes descent, revived ground, support, and transferred bounty as routed flow: provision serves a field or settlement when it is released, guided, retained, and replenished rather than arrested at its source.

parent_channels.name: S25. Whole-Surah Overdriven Mount Strands the Rider
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A rider mounts and presses an intense pace that overburdens the animal's back, disrupts its gait, and leaves the exhausted mount unable to continue, in contrast with easy travel.
parent_channels.active_motifs: mounting and riding an animal `quranic:root_001000:B011/m01`; punishing travel that loads the weak beyond capacity `quranic:root_000347:B012/m01`; an animal changing gait in motion `quranic:root_000544:B008/m01`; exhausted or disabled mount stranding its rider `quranic:root_000094:B004/m01`; easy and supple gait `quranic:root_000563:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Mounting, excessive pace, gait disruption, and stoppage form a causal travel failure, with easy motion as its functional contrast. The scene usefully pressures the command to race and the promise of walking light: urgency without regard for a carrier's capacity can terminate the journey, while sustained passage requires disciplined pace and care for what bears the load.

parent_channels.name: S26. Whole-Surah Widowhood Limits Adornment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: After her husband's death, a widow suspends ornament and dye, assumes mourning dress, and returns from the marital household to her kin.
parent_channels.active_motifs: widow's mourning abstention and mourning clothes `quranic:root_000002:B007/m01`; return to one's family after a husband's death `quranic:root_000544:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Mourning imposes a social limit on display and marks a household transition through death and return. Because the rite arises under the same root as iron and boundary, it reframes the surah's hard limit as disciplined restraint, while pressing worldly adornment to acknowledge mortality rather than continue as uninterrupted self-display.
